messages:
Dana (PM): Quick sync: we need a consent matrix + safety-net relay for private deploy upgrades. Goal: avoid surprise host-network edits and give field a rollback path. Draft ideas below.

Omar (eng): Propose consent matrix in installer: consent=opt-out|opt-in|require-signoff. Default opt-out = no host edits. Add --preset=relay to keep NAT and avoid touching customer egress. Dry-run prints plan + bundle sha.

Lina (field): Field asks: 1) printable preflight to hand to customers, 2) signed-bundle for airgap, 3) a simple "approve" token flow for netops signoff. Relay flow would be huge for early pilots.

Ralf (netops): Netops needs deterministic egress for audits. If preserve-egress can't be guaranteed preflight must FAIL. For signoff installs require: ASN, neighbor IPs, expected next-hops, and a checklist for firewall rules by vendor. Bridge/peer changes must not modify BGP attributes without explicit netops approval.

Omar (eng): Implementation sketch: installer --dry-run outputs preflight.json: {"mode":"signoff","planned_host_changes":["add-route"],"egress":"preserved|ephemeral","ports":[443,179],"bundle_sha":"..."} We persist to assets/<org>/<run>/preflight-<ts>.json and expose signed URL.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled preflight job for pilot-org-12 at 03:00 UTC

Dana (PM): Launch gates suggestion:
- 3 pilot customers with diverse topologies PASS preflight
- signed-bundle verification for airgap customers (field-run)
- relay fallback exercised on 2 pilots
- canary cohort of 5 installs with 60m observation and automatic revert if >2% critical failures
- revert tooling verified: installer revert --to-bundle=<sha> completes within 15m for 90% installs
If met, mark GA.

Lina (field): Action items: gather pilot nominees and draft 1-pager for customer playbook (generate bundle -> run verify -> return approval token). Also test relay flow with pilot A.

Ralf (netops): Action items: produce firewall mapping and signoff template (ETA 4d). Also provide a short list of ports that must be open for each preset.

Omar (eng): Action items: add --consent flag, --preset=relay, implement dry-run plan + bundle sha output (ETA 1w), and add metric handshake_fail_rate for pilots. Default preserve-egress=false.

Dana (PM): OK. Keep defaults conservative. We'll iterate on /docs/private/consent-matrix.md and sync Thursday. Ping me with pilot names.
